passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: We have a small garden, and I plant a seed in the soil.
phrases.ko: 우리에게는 작은 정원이 있고, 나는 흙에 씨를 심어요.
phrases.zh: 我们有一个小花园，我把种子种在土里。
phrases.py: wǒ men yǒu yí gè xiǎo huā yuán， wǒ bǎ zhǒng zi zhòng zài tǔ lǐ。
wǒ gěi zhǒng zi jiāo shuǐ。

phrases.zh: 一片绿色的叶子长出来了。
phrases.py: yī piàn lǜ sè de yè zi zhǎng chū lái le。
xī hóng shì biàn hóng le。
huā yuán lǐ yáng guāng hěn hǎo。

phrases.ko: 나는 먹을 것을 기르는 것이 좋아요.
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān zhòng kě yǐ chī de cài。

phrases.en: My mother helps me plant the seed.
phrases.ko: 어머니는 내가 씨를 심는 것을 도와요.
phrases.py: mā mā bāng zhù wǒ zhòng zhǒng zi。

phrases.en: I water the garden in the morning.
phrases.py: wǒ zǎo shàng gěi huā yuán jiāo shuǐ。

phrases.en: A sunny day helps the leaf grow.
phrases.ko: 햇빛이 좋은 날은 잎이 자라도록 도와요.
phrases.zh: 阳光好的日子帮助叶子长大。
phrases.py: yáng guāng hǎo de rì zi bāng zhù yè zi zhǎng dà。

phrases.en: We eat the red tomato at dinner.
phrases.zh: 晚饭时我们吃红红的西红柿。
phrases.py: wǎn fàn shí wǒ men chī hóng hóng de xī hóng shì。

phrases.en: I like our garden because we grow food there.
phrases.ko: 우리는 거기서 먹을 것을 기르기 때문에 정원을 좋아해요.
phrases.zh: 我们在那里种菜，所以我喜欢我们的花园。
phrases.py: wǒ men zài nà lǐ zhòng cài， suǒ yǐ wǒ xǐ huān wǒ men de huā yuán。

full_passage_spoken: We have a small garden, and I plant a seed in the soil. I water the seed. A green leaf grows. A tomato turns red. The garden is sunny. I like to grow food. My mother helps me plant the seed. I water the garden in the morning. A sunny day helps the leaf grow. We eat the red tomato at dinner. I like our garden because we grow food there.
full_passage_zh: 我们有一个小花园，我把种子种在土里。我给种子浇水。一片绿色的叶子长出来了。西红柿变红了。花园里阳光很好。我喜欢种可以吃的菜。妈妈帮助我种种子。我早上给花园浇水。阳光好的日子帮助叶子长大。晚饭时我们吃红红的西红柿。我们在那里种菜，所以我喜欢我们的花园。
